notes: All 24 source and 32 target IDs are partitioned exactly once.

In the linen garments the rectum is rendered anarthrously as an attributive, so rule 29's fronting case governs: the present article takes the single written the and the construct is left bare. The same reading is applied at vv. 32 and 33.
בְּבֹאוֹ divides as rule 52 and rule 18 require: when on the preposition, went on the infinitive, he on the suffix.
